info.name: Memberful GraphQL API
info.description: Memberful (Patreon-owned membership and subscription platform) GraphQL API. Single endpoint per account: POST https://{{account}}.memberful.com/api/graphql, bearer-token (API key) or OAuth 2.0 authenticated. Requests POST a GraphQL `query`. Queries are honestly modeled from Memberful's public docs and GraphQL API Explorer.

body.data: {"query":"query { member(id: \"1\") { id fullName email subscriptions { id active plan { id label } } } }"}

items.docs: Retrieve a single member with their subscriptions.

body.data: {"query":"query { members(first: 25) { edges { cursor node { id email fullName } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}
{"query":"mutation { memberCreate(email: \"new.member@example.com\", fullName: \"New Member\") { id email fullName } }"}

items.docs: Create a new member (documented example mutation).

body.data: {"query":"query { subscription(id: \"1\") { id active status autorenew plan { id label priceCents interval } member { email } } }"}

items.docs: Retrieve a single subscription with its plan and member.

body.data: {"query":"query { subscriptions(first: 25) { edges { node { id active status plan { label } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}
{"query":"query { passes { id name forSale plans { id label priceCents interval } } }"}

items.docs: List passes (dashboard "Plans") and the pricing plans within each.

body.data: {"query":"query { plans { id label priceCents currency interval intervalCount forSale } }"}

items.docs: List all plans (pricing options) across passes.

body.data: {"query":"query { orders(first: 25) { edges { cursor node { id number status totalCents currency member { email } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }"}

items.docs: List orders (transaction records) with cursor-based pagination.
